name: std-gantt-schedule
description: std-gantt-schedule — GENERIC view-only Gantt/timeline atom: fetches a task collection on INIT and renders it as bars on a day-scale axis via the gantt pattern, with group headers, dependency arrows, and a today marker. Fully rebindable: a host overrides the linked entity and points the field-mapping configs (labelField/startField/endField/durationField/statusField/groupField) at its own columns; clicking a bar emits the config-named onBarClick event with the row id. No drag-edit, no zoom — schedule viewing only.

schema.description: std-gantt-schedule — GENERIC view-only Gantt/timeline atom: fetches a task collection on INIT and renders it as bars on a day-scale axis via the gantt pattern, with group headers, dependency arrows, and a today marker. Fully rebindable: a host overrides the linked entity and points the field-mapping configs (labelField/startField/endField/durationField/statusField/groupField) at its own columns; clicking a bar emits the config-named onBarClick event with the row id. No drag-edit, no zoom — schedule viewing only.
schema.name: std-gantt-schedule

fields.description: task label shown on the bar
fields.name: title

fields.description: task start timestamp the bar is placed from
fields.name: start

fields.description: task end timestamp the bar is placed to; when absent, duration days are used
fields.name: end

fields.description: task lifecycle status, drives bar colour
fields.name: status

fields.description: group/section the task renders under a header row for
fields.name: group

dayWidth.description: Pixels per day on the time axis.
dayWidth.label: Day width

durationField.description: Row column holding the task length in days, used when the row has no end value. Empty = bars always read endField.
durationField.label: Duration field
durationField.synonyms: duration column, length field, days field

endField.description: Row column holding the end timestamp each bar is placed to. When a row has no end, durationField (days) is used instead.
endField.label: End field
endField.synonyms: end column, due field, finish field

groupField.description: Row column rows are grouped under header rows by (e.g. team, project). Empty (default) = flat list, no group headers.
groupField.label: Group field
groupField.synonyms: group column, swimlane field, section field

include.description: Entity relation field names to hydrate on fetch, so field mappings can use dot-paths like assignee.name. Empty = no hydration, the default.
include.label: Which relation fields to hydrate?
include.synonyms: relation hydration, populate relations, joined fields

labelField.description: Row column holding the bar label. Rebound hosts point this at their own column (e.g. name, summary).
labelField.label: Label field
labelField.synonyms: title field, label column, name field

links.description: Dependency arrows between task ids ({ from, to }); the host derives them from its own relation field and passes them here.
links.label: Dependency links

onBarClick.description: Event emitted when a bar is clicked: UI:{onBarClick} with { id } carrying the clicked row's id. Empty means bars are not clickable.
onBarClick.label: On bar click
onBarClick.synonyms: bar click, task click, select task, open task

rangeEnd.description: Last visible day (ISO date). Empty (default) = 2 days after the latest task end.
rangeEnd.label: Range end
rangeEnd.synonyms: window end, axis end, to date

rangeStart.description: First visible day (ISO date). Empty (default) = 2 days before the earliest task.
rangeStart.label: Range start
rangeStart.synonyms: window start, axis start, from date

showToday.description: Paint the today marker line when today falls inside the visible range.
showToday.label: Show today marker

startField.description: Row column holding the start timestamp each bar is placed from (e.g. startTime, startsAt, beginsAt).
startField.label: Start field
startField.synonyms: start column, from field, begin field

statusField.description: Row column holding the status value that drives bar colour.
statusField.label: Status field
statusField.synonyms: status column, state field, stage field

title.description: Header text shown above the gantt chart.
title.label: Title

emits.description: Indicates that schedule tasks have been successfully retrieved.
Indicates a failure to load schedule tasks.
Emitted when a gantt bar is clicked; { id } carries the clicked task row's id.

events.description: Indicates that schedule tasks have been successfully retrieved.
events.name: Task loaded

events.description: Indicates a failure to load schedule tasks.
events.name: Task load failed

events.description: Emitted when a gantt bar is clicked; { id } carries the clicked task row's id.
events.name: @config.on bar click
